subject: Follow-up: initial 30-min product preview + ops/security attendees
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@evernode.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: initial 30-min product preview + ops/security attendees

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary use case: accelerate customer support responses using embeddings + reranking for ticket history.
- Key constraints: sub-second latency for quick lookups, data residency in US, and audit/logging for compliance.
- Stakeholders we heard: Support lead (you), Security/compliance, and 1–2 engineering reviewers for integrations.

Next step: schedule a 30-minute product preview (high-level demo + Q&A) to show a short walkthrough of Redwood inference and the ops/observability surface. Can you pick one of these windows? All times are Pacific (PT) — happy to convert if helpful.

Option A — Tue, Oct 27 — 10:00–10:30 PT
Option B — Wed, Oct 28 — 14:00–14:30 PT
Option C — Thu, Oct 29 — 08:30–09:00 PT

Please let me know: 1) which option works, and 2) who from Security/Engineering will join (name + email). If none of these fit, tell me a couple slots that do and we’ll adjust.

Attached: short proposed agenda (30 min) and a one-pager on observability features. I CC'd Marissa (AE) who will join the meeting. If you'd like a deeper technical deep-dive after the preview, we can loop in Karthik (solutions engineering).

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0156
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: initial 30-min product preview + ops/security attendees

Priyom — thanks for the clear recap. Option B (Wed, Oct 28 — 14:00–14:30 PT) works best for our group.

I'll have our security lead join: Jared Park (jared.park@evernode.com). He'll handle the compliance questions. Also copying in our engineering reviewer (I'll add them to the calendar invite after you send it).

Two quick asks before the meeting:
1) Can you include a brief slide on audit/logging (what events are persisted, retention options)?
2) Any notes on network connectivity for private deployments (VPC/HSM) — high level is fine.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Lowe
Head of Support, Evernode
samantha.lowe@evernode.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: initial 30-min product preview + ops/security attendees

Thanks Samantha — Wed, Oct 28 14:00–14:30 PT is locked. I've attached the agenda and added a calendar invite (invite attached as .ics). Karthik (cc'd) will join to handle the network/VPC and deployment questions Jared mentioned.

Quick notes addressing your asks:
- Audit/logging: we'll cover which events are logged (request metadata, evaluation IDs, API call traces), retention controls, and how customers stream logs to their SIEM. See page 2 of the attached agenda for bullets.
- Network/connectivity: Karthik will summarize VPC peering, private control plane options, and KMS integration for key material during the demo.

Action items:
- Priyom: send invite + attach agenda (done).
- Samantha: confirm if your engineering reviewer will be joining (add to invite).
- Jared: if there are specific compliance docs you want in advance (SOC2 section, audit log schema), let me know and we'll share prior to the meeting.

Looking forward to it.

—Priyom
Priyom Das | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0156
